meaning: A small box that shares your home's internet with your phones, TVs, and computers. It sends data to the right device.
clues: It is the box in your home that makes the wireless network and sends each message to the right device.
It is usually a small box with a few antennas and blinking lights.
Your phone joins the network it makes, and that network has a name and a password.
It plugs into the modem with a cable.
It has six letters and starts with R.
assumes: A modem connects your home to your internet company
A network switch links wired devices
A range extender boosts a wireless signal

decoys.meaning: A box that connects your home to your internet company's line.
A box that links many wired devices together, such as in an office.
A gadget that boosts a wireless signal so it reaches farther.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Back in my day, one phone line meant one person online at a time. Now this little box juggles the whole family!

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Tip: when the internet acts up, unplug the router for ten seconds and plug it back in.
